Maya G: Quick follow-up: AP-467 remediation items are overdue in the tracker. Owners: @Tom R (deploy rollback test), @Izzy V (monitoring thresholds). Who's on status?
Tom R: Sorry, I started the rollback test but hit an environment quota in staging. Filed STAGE-8. Waiting on infra quota increase.
Izzy V: Monitoring thresholds draft is in confluence but I haven't had a chance to validate with prod-data. Need access to the sanitized dataset.
remind-bot: Reminder: AP-467 actions overdue. Escalate in 36h if no update.
Maya G: We need concrete ETAs or reassign. If quota isn't lifted by tomorrow noon, I'll reassign to on-call to keep SLA.
Tom R: Adding ETA: quota ticket STAGE-8 assigned to infra, requested by 2026-06-02 11:00 PT. If not actioned, ok to reassign.
Izzy V: Requesting dataset access in DATA-19. QA Lead, could you confirm when sanitized snapshot will be available?
QA Lead: We can provide a snapshot by EOD tomorrow if data team approves. Adding task to our sprint.
Eng Manager: Noted pattern: we're seeing 3 incidents this quarter delayed by "external approvals" and env access. Let's add a standard action to postmortems: "verify env & data access before assigning owner".
Maya G: Agreed. Please update the PM template and tracker. Tom/Izzie, update the tracker with the ETAs and blockers.
Tom R: STAGE-8 was approved and quota bumped. Running rollback tests now.
Izzy V: Got data snapshot access; validating thresholds against snapshot. Will post results by 16:00 PT.
remind-bot: Closure verification scheduled for 2026-06-04 17:00 PT.
Maya G: Thanks team. If both items pass verification I'll mark AP-467 closed and file a retro card for access gating.
Tom R: Rollback tests passed in staging, push to prod-canary planned.
Izzy V: Thresholds validated, updated monitor runbook.
Maya G: Marking verified in tracker. Eng Manager, please track retro card assignment.
